about: Radio call-outs, round 2 (2026-10-21): a call for every step and outcome, from a pool of two or more lines, so steps in a row don't say the same words (ReplaySounds deals lines). Each pool is a sound: 'extends' adds lines to one already in make_radio_sounds.py, otherwise it's new. 'steps' are the step types (and timelines) it's meant for, 'outcome' the variant, 'visual' whether the lines were written against the timelines' own glitch and failure (steps/*.jsx headers) or only the step's family. make_callouts.py --lines=round2.json generates every line here; the user picks the takes, then the kept ones go into make_radio_sounds.py and cues.json.
